name: Wednesday Night Chaos — January 5, 2000

date.source: The fed's own served broadcast script dates itself "January 5, 2000" (file name WNC0105.html).

matches.note: Nightstryker turned Aries's own early flurry around and finished him with his own finisher two and a half minutes in.

Creed kicked out of an early cradle pin, then won by disqualification after The Magician shoved the referee and kept up a chair attack; two masked men wearing reigning champion Stephen "the Monkey" McDonald's own symbol then ran in and drove off The Magician.

Billed as a tag match, "Fletcher and Reese vs. the Band" — Styx (of the Band) was absent, billed as having been dragged behind a car by a masked man two weeks earlier; Fletcher and Reese settled which of them would wrestle Heavy Metal with a rock-paper-scissors toss (Reese won the toss and stood down), and Fletcher won the resulting singles match with the Diamond Dog after roughly ten minutes. The Band's own third member, Juggs, walked to ringside with Heavy Metal but did not wrestle.

Challengers Rage and Ashe (billed "Natural Selection") against champions the Brothers Grimm (Sirus Moran and Grifter). The match went unresolved: the arena lights cut out mid-match, and when they returned Rage and Ashe were found beaten and strung up in the rafters by a debuting stable billed "the family" (Faith, suspended on a harness controlled by Blood, delivering an extended promo; the Crippler looking on approvingly from the top of the ramp). No fall was scored and no result was called on air; the Brothers Grimm's own reign continues unbroken in the fed's own Tag Team Title ledger.

Cinergy, joined by Prima Donna, beat Fear down outside the ring and drove his head into a chair with repeated finishers; the referee called for the bell on seeing the weapon shot, then was himself kicked and struck by Cinergy, who continued the assault until security intervened. Fear was stretchered out; the broadcast closes without confirming his condition.

notes: "Wednesday Night Chaos," the fed's own weekly broadcast, hosted from the PWA's own "Chaos Room" by Bud Adams before handing off to arena commentators Jon McDaniel and Brian Rentfro at the PWA Dome in St. Louis for the show's double main event. The broadcast's own opening commentary references a faction billed "MoA" ("the ADC has been quick to have orders for MoA the PWA Chapter created"; later, of Sirus Moran's own missing bear 'Al,' "the MoA did Sirus a favour") without staging any of its members directly on this card; held here as a named but unstructured reference, not minted.
